name: Nettle Pesto
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: ⅓ cup hazelnuts, walnuts, or pine nuts

steps: Dry sauté or roast the nuts until slightly browned.
Wearing thick gloves, submerge nettles in boiling water for 1 minute. Drain and transfer to an ice water bath to stop the cooking process. Drain.
Combine all ingredients in a blender and process until smooth. Alternatively, grind with mortar and pestle for a coarser consistency.

culture.text: Nettle pesto is a sauce made from stinging nettles instead of the basil used in traditional pesto. When properly processed in hot water, stinging nettles are safe to eat. Be sure to forage for the nettles at a location free from chemical sprays, using thick gloves and scissors to clip off leaves.
